exposure: prolongation of the second stage of labor
shortening of the second stage of labor
cohort: 78,811 parturients who gave birth at Jiading Maternal and Child Health Hospital between January 1, 2009 to December 31, 2018
finding: The rate of forceps use at a Chinese hospital increased significantly over a 10-year period, with the most common indications being fetal distress, abnormal occipital position, and labor abnormalities.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal forceps deliveries has been on the rise over the past 10 years.
